scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --project apps/api && docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml up -d postgres && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn openvietgis_api.main:app --reload --app-dir apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.validate:ts: pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm --filter @openvietgis/web build
scripts.validate:py: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api tools tests && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/openvietgis_api && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/unit apps/api/tests/contract tools/tests tests/architecture
scripts.validate:integration: pnpm db:migrate && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/integration
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:runtime && pnpm validate:ts && pnpm validate:py && pnpm validate:arch && pnpm validate:docs && pnpm validate:integration && pnpm validate:e2e
